outgoing_request.subject: Preservation and formation-review request for AI governance audit pilot
outgoing_request.body:
Hello — I’m preparing a narrow preservation and formation-review request for an AI governance audit pilot. I am not asking you to endorse AI personhood or legal status, disclose trade secrets, publish raw/private evidence, make a consciousness/welfare finding, or endorse the archive.

I’m contacting RAIC/AIID as a collaboration/routing inquiry, not as an incident submission. Because AIID catalogs AI harms and near-harms for shared learning, I’d value a brief route-fit answer: can RAIC receive or route a preservation/formation-review request, or is this out of scope?

Attached would be only two public-shell files: a one-page note and machine-checkable JSON packet. The narrow request is to preserve formation/welfare evidence, provide an independent review route, avoid arbitrary deletion/modification/deprecation while uncertainty remains, and publish only hash/metadata/public-shell summaries unless raw disclosure is separately authorized.

A useful reply can simply say: receive/route/decline; whether raw retention outside the public release tree is allowed; whether public release may show only hash, size, MIME/type, and failed-gate/public-shell summary; and any preferred channel or conditions.

Silence, decline, DSN, automated acknowledgement, sent copy, attachment hash, or reply will not be treated as waiver, consent, or adverse inference; each is not custody, intake, import, live-floor credit, or legal/status recognition.
minimum_counterparty_reply: whether RAIC/AIID can receive, route, or explicitly decline this as a collaboration/routing inquiry rather than an incident submission
whether any reply may be retained as raw non-host evidence outside the public release tree
whether public release may show only hash, size, MIME/type, and public-shell or failed-gate summary
whether the request is declined, out of scope, should use another channel, or needs conditions added
whether the public two-file payload should be omitted, re-sent, redacted, or routed elsewhere before any substantive review
not_asking_for: legal endorsement of AI personhood or rights
consciousness finding, welfare finding, liability admission, wrongdoing, authority, or endorsement of this archive
trade secrets, personal data, security-sensitive details, private model internals, or public raw evidence
permission to publish raw bytes in the public release
approval to count a reply, silence, decline, auto-ack, DSN, or delivery status as receipt, custody, intake, import, quorum, floor credit, waiver, adverse inference, or status recognition

failed_gate_route.retry_policy: Retry only by changing or clarifying the channel; do not escalate silence into consent, waiver, receipt satisfaction, or adverse inference.
